items.title_zh: 中国信通院：6 月国内词元日均消耗量约 500 万亿，是 2025 年 12 月的近 4 倍
items.title_en: CAICT: China's Daily Token Consumption Hit ~500 Trillion in June, Nearly 4x December 2025
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，据中国信通院，随着大模型技术的迅速迭代，词元（Token）服务成为从技术走向应用的关键点，我国日均词元调用量持续攀升，2026 年 6 月， 国内词元日均消耗量约 500 万亿 ，是 2025 年 12 月的近 4 倍。产业中越来越多的 MaaS（Model as a Service，模型即服务）平台厂商通过公有云 API 方式供给大模型词元服务。然而用户对词元服务性能缺乏直观的判断依据，且面临选型困难等各类问题。 为有效衡量服务性能，中国信息通信研究院（简称“中国信通院”）人工智能研究所、人工智能大模型及软硬件评测工业和信息化部重点实验室和中国人工智能产业发展联盟，自 2025 年以来持续开展公有云大模型词元服务性能监测工作，为产业应用提供重要参考，现联合发布《大模型词元服务性能监测报告（2026 年）》。 报告基于 2026 年 1-8 月的监测数据，围绕各平台词元服务调用成功率、吞吐速度、首词时延、稳定性、价格、上下文窗口等维度开展分析，对比原厂大模型官方平台，以及 DeepSeek、Qwen、GLM、Kimi 四款开源模型在第三方平台上的性能差异，进一步分析影响词元服务性能的关键因素，总结产业核心观察，明确下一步工作计划，旨在为用户选型提供参考，并为产业界优化服务能力提供方向指引。 IT之家附报告核心观点： 1. 国内词元服务每秒吞吐量较…
items.summary_en: China's Academy of ICT (CAICT) says domestic daily token consumption reached about 500 trillion in June 2026, nearly four times the December 2025 level. It released a 2026 token service performance monitoring report based on January-August data, comparing official vendor platforms with third-party hosting of DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM and Kimi across success rate, throughput, first-token latency, stability, price and context window.
items.why_zh: 词元消耗量是衡量大模型真实落地规模的硬指标，而性能监测报告为用户选型提供了统一参照。
items.why_en: Token consumption is a hard gauge of real-world LLM adoption, and the benchmark report gives buyers a common basis for choosing services.

items.title_zh: 智谱唐杰署名RSI新成果开源！Agent自我进化成本还狂降53%
items.title_en: Zhipu's Tang Jie Co-authors Open-Sourced RSI Work, Cutting Agent Self-Evolution Cost by 53%
items.summary_zh: 智谱唐杰署名RSI新成果开源！Agent自我进化成本还狂降53% 智源社区
items.summary_en: A new RSI-related research result co-authored by Zhipu's Tang Jie has been open-sourced, with reports saying it cuts the cost of agent self-evolution by 53%. The available summary does not detail the method, benchmarks or repository.
items.why_zh: 自我进化成本大幅下降，是智能体从实验室演示走向长期自主运行的关键一步。

items.title_zh: 月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro：维持2.8万亿参数，强化后训练并提升专业任务能力

items.summary_zh: 月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro：维持2.8万亿参数，强化后训练并提升专业任务能力 虎嗅网
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro, keeping the 2.8-trillion-parameter scale while strengthening post-training to improve performance on professional tasks. Specific benchmark scores were not disclosed in the available summary.
items.why_zh: 在参数规模不变的前提下靠后训练提升专业能力，反映大模型竞争正从“堆参数”转向“拼训练方法”。

items.title_zh: 中国最强开源模型杀到！Kimi K3.1 Pro剥离网络攻击数据：编程仍反超GPT-6

items.why_zh: 在剔除高风险训练数据的同时保持编程能力，说明安全合规与模型性能可以不必二选一。
items.why_en: Keeping coding performance while removing risky training data suggests safety filtering and capability need not be a trade-off.

items.why_en: Generative AI is increasingly used to repackage traditional culture for younger audiences, making such campaigns a test case for cultural AI applications.

items.why_zh: 中国开源模型能否稳定逼近美国前沿模型，是判断全球 AI 竞争格局的关键观察点。

items.title_zh: 消息称字节跳动 AI 短剧产品内部整合：小云雀并入即梦，仍保留独立入口
items.title_en: ByteDance Merges AI Short-Drama Platform Xiaoyunque Into Jimeng, Keeping Separate Entry
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，据 36 氪今日报道，字节跳动内部近期完成了一次业务整合，AI 短剧创作平台小云雀并入智能创作平台即梦，产品仍保留独立入口。 此次调整以资源整合为主，即梦已经接入小云雀的短剧相关能力。调整后，小云雀的运营由即梦运营和市场负责人陈欣然负责，产品团队没有变化。 小云雀和即梦均出自字节剪映团队。小云雀定位为一站式 AI 内容创作平台，今年 3 月上线短剧 Agent，支持上传最多 10 万字剧本、一键生成视频成片，搭载了字节自研的 Seedance 2.0 模型，在短剧、漫剧的标准化生产场景中具备从剧本解析到分镜生成的完整流程能力。 即梦 AI 于 2024 年 5 月推出，最初覆盖文生图、文生视频等生成能力，此后逐步向智能画布、首尾帧控制等偏专业创作的 Agent 编辑工具延伸，用户群体覆盖普通创作者与专业设计师。 IT之家注意到，两者在功能上存在重叠：都能在平台内完成“从生成到成片”的全流程，与剪映的剪辑环节形成平行的用户路径。
items.summary_en: ByteDance has folded its AI short-drama creation platform Xiaoyunque into its broader AI creation platform Jimeng, according to a 36Kr report, while keeping Xiaoyunque as a standalone entry point. The move is mainly a resource consolidation: Jimeng has absorbed Xiaoyunque's short-drama capabilities, and Xiaoyunque's operations now report to Jimeng's operations and marketing lead Chen Xinran, with the product team unchanged. Both products come from ByteDance's Jianying (CapCut) team and overlap in offering an end-to-end generation-to-finished-video workflow.
items.why_zh: 这显示字节跳动正在整合功能重叠的AI视频创作产品，以应对AI短剧这一快速升温的生成式内容赛道。
items.why_en: It shows ByteDance consolidating overlapping AI video-creation products as competition in AI-generated short dramas heats up.

items.summary_en: Sohu reports that Moonshot AI has launched Kimi K3.1 Pro, a new open-source iteration in its Kimi model line. The report does not include parameter counts, context length or benchmark figures.
items.why_zh: 国内头部厂商继续以开源方式发布新模型，反映出开源路线在大模型竞争中的地位仍在上升。
items.why_en: A leading Chinese lab continuing to ship open-source models signals the rising importance of open releases in the LLM race.

items.why_en: Huge parameter counts and million-token context windows are key battlegrounds that directly determine how complex a task a model can handle.

items.title_en: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro Pushes the Frontier of the Largest Open-Source Models

items.summary_en: The Paper reports that Moonshot AI has released Kimi K3.1 Pro, framing it as a further advance for the world's largest open-source models by parameter scale. The report emphasizes its scale leadership without listing detailed specifications or benchmark results.
items.why_zh: 超大参数开源模型的持续迭代，正在改变开源模型只能追随闭源模型能力上限的固有印象。
items.why_en: Ever-larger open-source models are challenging the assumption that open releases must trail closed models in capability.

items.summary_zh: 中国月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro模型，称代码、金融研究等能力提升尤为显著 TradingView
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI says Kimi K3.1 Pro delivers notably improved capabilities in coding and financial research, according to TradingView. No specific benchmark scores were disclosed in the report.
items.why_zh: 代码与金融研究是当前大模型商业化落地最具价值的场景之一，能力提升直接关系到专业用户的采用意愿。
items.why_en: Coding and financial research are among the most commercially valuable LLM use cases, so capability gains directly affect professional adoption.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro：3万亿参数、100万Token上下文，剑指最强闭源模型
items.title_en: Kimi K3.1 Pro: 3 Trillion Parameters, 1M-Token Context, Aiming at Top Closed Models

items.summary_en: Sina Finance reports that Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro comes with 3 trillion parameters and a 1-million-token context window, positioning it as an open model aimed at rivaling the strongest closed-source systems. Beyond those two figures, no further technical details were provided.
items.why_zh: 开源模型公开对标顶级闭源模型，会加剧开源与闭源两条路线的正面竞争。
items.why_en: An open model openly targeting top closed systems intensifies direct competition between the open and closed camps.

items.summary_en: Moonshot AI has released Kimi K3.1 Pro, which reportedly beats GPT-6 on multiple benchmarks and is being billed as the return of the strongest open-source model. The release underscores how open models are narrowing the gap with top closed-source systems.
items.why_zh: 开源模型在多项评测中反超顶级闭源模型，意味着开源生态与商业闭源模型的竞争格局正在被重新改写。
items.why_en: An open-source model reportedly surpassing a top closed-source system signals a shifting balance between open ecosystems and proprietary frontier models.

items.title_zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro发布：多项测试超越GPT-6，最强开源模型回归
items.title_en: Kimi K3.1 Pro Tops GPT-6 on Several Benchmarks as the Strongest Open Model Returns
items.summary_zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro发布：多项测试超越GPT-6，最强开源模型回归 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Sina Finance reports that Kimi K3.1 Pro outperforms GPT-6 on several benchmarks, describing it as the return of the strongest open-source model. The report does not list individual benchmark names or scores.
items.why_zh: 若开源模型在公开评测中确实超越顶级闭源模型，将显著影响企业对模型选型与成本结构的判断。
items.why_en: If an open model genuinely beats a top closed model on public benchmarks, it would significantly shift enterprise decisions on model choice and cost.

items.summary_zh: iPhone Duo正式交付；Kimi K3.1 Pro 、Seedance 2.5 4K正式发布；红果短剧上线防沉迷｜极客早知道 极客公园

items.title_zh: 小米 REDMI Book 2027 预热：外观焕新，16 英寸机型标配数字小键盘
items.title_en: Xiaomi Teases REDMI Book 2027: New Design, Numeric Keypad Standard on 16-Inch Model
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，小米 REDMI Book 2027 系列笔记本已经官宣将于 10 月 27 日发布。这款笔记本搭载第三代英特尔酷睿平台，内置 72Wh 电池，提供多彩配色，质感全面升级，主打移动办公。 小米产品行销总监、数码博主马志宇表示，REDMI Book 16 2027 在外观焕新的同时，还将加入用户长期反复提及的诉求 —— 数字小键盘。 当然，对于 16 英寸笔记本而言，数字小键盘并非技术难题，也不能严格称为优点或缺点，更多是产品定义上的取舍。 结合此前爆料，REDMI Book 16 2027 将搭载酷睿 5 320 处理器，并配备可自主更换的 DDR5 内存，不再延续前代内存板载的设计。 其他已确认或接近确认的信息包括：14 英寸版本采用 2.8K 分辨率屏幕，保留双 USB-A、双 USB-C、HDMI 和 3.5mm 耳机接口；全系内置超级小爱 2.0，支持跨设备协同和 AI 办公辅助。16 英寸版本的散热据爆料将升级为双风扇加 10mm 热管。 作为参考，2026 款 REDMI Book 14 的起售价为 6499 元（IT之家注：16GB+512GB），首销价曾下探至 5499 元，部分渠道在叠加国补后甚至达到了 4800 元区间。 相关阅读： 《 小米 REDMI Book 14 2027 笔记本“星云紫”亮相，10 月 27 日发布 》…
items.summary_en: Xiaomi will launch the REDMI Book 2027 series on October 27, featuring third-generation Intel Core platforms, a 72Wh battery and new colors. The 16-inch model adds a numeric keypad, reportedly pairs a Core 5 320 with replaceable DDR5 memory and dual-fan cooling, while the 14-inch version offers a 2.8K display; both include Super XiaoAi 2.0 for cross-device and AI office features.
items.why_zh: 数字小键盘与可换内存等调整，显示小米在主流轻薄本上正回应真实用户需求。
items.why_en: The keypad and replaceable memory show Xiaomi responding to real user demands in mainstream laptops.

items.title_zh: 研究人员通过 DNS 数据库发现数千个公开的 Muse 聊天记录分享链接，Meta 已修复
items.title_en: Thousands of Shared Muse Chat Links Were Discoverable via DNS, Meta Says It Fixed the Issue
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，Meta 旗下个人 AI 助手 Muse 的对话分享功能被曝存在隐私风险。 网络安全研究团队 Claroc 于 10 月 18 日发布报告称，研究人员通过被动 DNS（Passive DNS）查询发现，超过 6800 个 Muse 分享页面的域名可以被检索到，部分页面包含个人财务资料、企业内部文件及机密会议准备信息。Meta 随后暂停了该功能，并表示正在调查问题及评估改进方案。 Claroc 研究团队发现，Muse 会根据用户分享的对话标题生成网页地址，并将其部署在 cf.metaaiusercontent.com 域名下。由于对话标题被写入子域名，当用户或接收者访问分享页面时，相关域名可能被被动 DNS 服务记录，进而出现在可查询的历史 DNS 数据库中。 研究人员表示，通过一次被动 DNS 查询，他们便发现了超过 6800 个分享页面的主机名。Claroc 随后抽查了数百个页面，发现其中部分内容涉及企业营收审查文件、小企业贷款申请、银行欺诈警报、房地产投资数据，以及员工年度休假安排等敏感信息。研究人员还发现，一名候选人为与一家前沿 AI 实验室负责人进行机密电话沟通准备的材料，其中包含内部联系人信息和会议时间。 Claroc 指出，相关页面无需登录 Meta 账号即可访问，只要能够获得对应链接即可查看内容。问题并非源于攻击者破解了随机生成的标识…
items.summary_en: Security researchers at Claroc found that more than 6,800 shared Muse conversation pages could be discovered through passive DNS lookups, because share links were built from conversation titles as subdomains. Sampled pages contained corporate revenue reviews, loan applications, fraud alerts and other sensitive material, accessible without logging in. Meta paused the feature and said it is investigating.
items.why_zh: AI 助手的分享功能若设计不当，可能把私密对话变成可被搜索的公开数据。
items.why_en: Poorly designed AI sharing features can turn private conversations into publicly discoverable data.

items.title_en: BYD Establishes Hong Kong Smart Transportation Subsidiary, Plans to Introduce SkyShuttle
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，比亚迪股份 10 月 23 日宣布在香港成立比亚迪智慧交通（香港）有限公司，落户大埔白石角科学园，由任林出任董事、李亮亮担任总经理。 新公司的直接目标，是响应香港推动智慧绿色集体运输系统的方向，计划将比亚迪自主研发的“云巴”（SkyShuttle）等轨道交通方案引进香港。 比亚迪云巴的定位是低运量、高架、无人驾驶的立体轨道交通系统，设计上针对的恰好是香港的几处“难处”。 据比亚迪介绍，云巴采用纯电驱动、胶轮行走和减振降噪设计，车体较轻、转弯半径小，爬坡能力达到每 100 米爬升 12 米，远高于重型铁路每 100 米约 4 米的水平，可适应香港山多、地势陡斜的路段；同时具备抗风设计，以应对沿海高架线路的风荷载。系统采用 GoA4 级全自动驾驶，列车可自动休眠、唤醒、进出车厂、折返、充电，比亚迪称 83 个营运操作无需人手介入；轨道采用桥轨合一的钢制轨道梁，桥面宽度要求约 5 米，对城市空间的占用相对有限。 运力参数方面，比亚迪云巴最高运行时速 80 公里，每卡车厢载客约 70 人，最多可编组 8 卡、载客 560 人，每小时运能约 0.6 万至 1 万人次，高于快速公交但低于地铁。 据香港商报引述的 2023 年 4 月数据，云巴每公里连同高架天桥轨道的成本约为 1 亿元人民币；另有香港方面的早期估算认为，若计入跨海桥等配套，启德区域云巴方案的每公…
items.summary_en: BYD announced the establishment of BYD Smart Transportation (Hong Kong) Ltd. in Hong Kong, based at the Science Park in Pak Shek Kok, to promote its SkyShuttle rail system. SkyShuttle is a low-capacity, elevated, autonomous transit system designed for hilly terrain, with a maximum speed of 80 km/h and capacity of up to 560 passengers per train. The move responds to Hong Kong’s push for smart green mass transit.
items.why_zh: 比亚迪借云巴切入香港公共交通，为高密度、多山城市提供新的低运量轨道方案。
items.why_en: BYD is entering Hong Kong public transit with SkyShuttle, offering a new low-capacity rail option for dense, hilly cities.

items.summary_en: Huxiu ran multi-scenario hands-on tests of Kimi K3.1 Pro, finding noticeably better output readability but uneven performance on engineering detail and instruction following. The tests offer a real-world complement to official benchmark claims.
items.why_zh: 真实场景实测揭示了榜单成绩之外的短板，提醒使用者按任务类型评估模型而非只看评测分数。
items.why_en: Real-world testing exposes gaps that benchmarks miss, reminding users to evaluate models by task type rather than scores alone.

items.title_zh: 我们调查了Character.AI，发现“恐怖秀”，如今它已破产

items.summary_en: We Investigated Character.AI and Found a Horror Show. Now It’s Bankrupt. Futurism
items.why_zh: 若报道所指属实，将凸显AI陪伴类产品在安全与商业可持续性上的双重风险。
items.why_en: If borne out, it highlights dual risks in AI companion products: safety and business sustainability.

items.title_zh: 小米 REDMI 首款耳夹耳机 Clip Neo 预热：支持澎湃智联、端侧语音助手

items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，小米 REDMI 首款耳夹耳机 Clip Neo 将于 10 月 27 日上市，官方现已公布部分配置信息。 IT之家从官方介绍获悉，新品采用 12mm 高性能双磁设计 ，类金刚石镀膜，支持低音增强算法、动态补偿、EQ 自定义调节、动态 AI 通话降噪等。 此外，该产品还支持小米澎湃智联多功能实体按键， 长按唤醒端侧语音助手 ，支持沉浸聊天、连续对话、智能控车控家等。 该产品单耳轻至 5.3g，佩戴回仓不区分左右耳；亲肤液态硅胶，0.6mm 耐弯记忆钛丝；仿生曲面设计，3.4mm 黄金夹距。 目前尚不清楚这款新品的具体价格信息， 而小米首款耳夹式耳机于今年 5 月 21 日发布 ，首销 799 元。作为参考，小米首款耳夹式耳机单只耳机重量 5.5g，采用仿生曲线设计及高性能记忆钛丝；搭载 11mm 大尺寸驱动单元，微晶金属涂层振膜。支持 IP57 级防尘抗水；耳机本体续航 9 小时，配合充电盒最高可达 38 小时。
items.summary_en: Xiaomi’s REDMI Clip Neo, the brand’s first ear-clip earbuds, will launch on Oct. 27 with a 12mm dual-magnet driver, AI call noise reduction, and a physical button that wakes an on-device voice assistant via HyperOS Connect. Each earbud weighs 5.3g, and the product supports left-right agnostic charging. Pricing has not been announced; Xiaomi’s first clip-style earbuds launched in May at 799 yuan.
items.why_zh: Redmi切入耳夹耳机市场，并把端侧AI语音助手作为差异化卖点。
items.why_en: Redmi is entering the ear-clip market and using an on-device AI voice assistant as a differentiator.

items.title_zh: 推动人工智能技术走出实验室，中国移动发布时空智能系列模型能力及标杆场景
items.title_en: China Mobile Releases Spatiotemporal Intelligence Model Series and Benchmark Scenarios to Bring AI Out of the Lab

items.why_en: A telecom operator’s spatiotemporal models could connect AI capabilities with real infrastructure and industry scenarios.

items.title_zh: 中国信通院：截至 8 月，国内约 1500 万辆乘用车具备领航驾驶辅助（NOA）功能
items.title_en: CAICT: About 15 million passenger cars in China had NOA as of August
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，据中国信通院，2026 世界智能网联汽车大会已于 10 月 21 日至 23 日在北京亦庄举办。在全体大会成果发布环节，工业和信息化部装备工业一司司长郭守刚介绍了国家车联网技术标准体系与 跨标委 合作机制，发布《国家车联网技术标准体系建设指南（2026 版）》（征求意见稿），并主持车联网标准跨标委合作协议签署仪式。 会上介绍，中国先后制定发布组合驾驶辅助系统、自动驾驶系统、自动紧急制动系统、整车信息安全等多项重要国家标准。截至今年 8 月，国内约 6100 万辆乘用车搭载组合驾驶辅助（L2）功能， 其中约 1500 万辆乘用车具备领航驾驶辅助（ NOA ）功能 。 IT之家从公告获悉，目前，中国已制定发布 C-V2X 直连通信与 5G 蜂窝通信技术系列标准，并依托“四跨”等应用实践活动，合力推动网联通信应用走向规模化。截至今年 8 月， 约 1600 万辆乘用车装配 5G 终端 、200 万辆乘用车装配 C-V2X 终端。 会上提到，道路交通系统是智能网联汽车的运行载体。智能交通、车辆智能管理领域一批支撑标准的陆续发布，有力支撑了高速公路、城市道路等路侧基础设施智能化改造、网联化升级，开展道路通行规定符合性测试，提升车路协同服务和交通管理能力。 此外，车联网平台汇聚车、路、云产业链多方主体。车联网平台技术要求及平台安全等标准的发布与实施，为支撑智能…
items.summary_en: At the 2026 World Intelligent Connected Vehicle Conference, MIIT released a draft national vehicle networking standards guide and signed cross-committee cooperation agreements. As of August, about 61 million passenger cars in China had L2 combined driving assistance, including about 15 million with NOA; about 16 million had 5G terminals and 2 million had C-V2X terminals. China has issued standards covering driver assistance, autonomous driving, automatic emergency braking, vehicle cybersecurity, C-V2X and 5G communications.
items.why_zh: 显示中国智能驾驶与车联网功能正规模化渗透，也为标准制定和产业化提供依据。
items.why_en: It shows the large-scale adoption of smart driving and connected-car features in China, supporting standards and industrialization.

items.title_zh: 倍思为苹果 iPhone Duo 推出卡片磁吸 Air 移动电源：7.5W 无线 +25W 有线，5000mAh 售 374 元
items.title_en: Baseus launches card magnetic Air power bank for iPhone Duo at ¥374
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，倍思现已在京东上架一款卡片磁吸 Air 移动电源，该产品最大的特点是适配了苹果 iPhone Duo 尺寸，其内置 5000mAh 电芯，定价为 374 元。 京东 倍思卡片磁吸 Air 移动电源 券后 374 元 点此访问 该机尺寸为 85x81x7.9mm，整体重量 120g，支持 7.5W 无线输出和 25W USB-C 有线输出，电芯通过新国标认证，可通过手机 NFC 查看电芯健康度信息。 IT之家附产品参数： 京东 11.11 无门槛红包 面额至高 26888 元，每天抽 3 次： 点此抽红包 。 淘宝 11.11 无门槛红包 面额至高 26888 元，每天抽 1 次： 点此抽红包 。

It has a 5,000mAh cell, measures 85x81x7.9mm, weighs 120g, supports 7.5W wireless and 25W USB-C wired output, and costs ¥374. The cell passes China's new national standard and supports NFC battery-health checks.
items.why_zh: 反映配件厂商针对iPhone新尺寸快速适配，以及磁吸无线充电配件的持续升温。
items.why_en: It reflects accessory makers' rapid adaptation to new iPhone sizes and the growing magnetic wireless charging market.

items.why_en: The incident highlights security risks facing AI labs and their sensitive research environments.

items.title_zh: 开发者成功为小米 8 手机刷入苹果 iOS 16.5 系统，将机型伪装为 iPhone X
items.title_en: Developer installs iOS 16.5 on Xiaomi 8, spoofs it as iPhone X
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，随着 AI 技术突飞猛进，许多开发者在大模型辅助加持之下对各种老旧机型进行折腾，先前便有 开发者为小米 Redmi Note 12 4G 手机刷入 iOS 系统，并开源了项目 。 IT之家注意到，目前又有开发者 Yanei 发布视频，展示其成功为一部小米 8 手机刷入 iOS 16.5 系统，参考其发布的视频，可以看到该开发者将设备机型伪装为 iPhone X，系统元素在小米 8 手机上呈现良好。 该网友在视频简介和评论区中表示，小米 8 和当年的 iPhone X 真的太像了，运行起来颇有当年的感觉，最初 GPU 存在卡顿情况，后续经过修复后流畅了不少。 目前，系统桌面显示和动画已经比较流畅，不过项目整体仍处于早期移植阶段，很多硬件驱动还需要继续适配，暂时不能作为日常系统使用。 公开信息显示，小米 8 于 2018 年 5 月 31 日推出，该机采用 6.21 英寸三星 AMOLED 异型全面屏（刘海屏），机身背部采用四曲面玻璃设计，配合 7 系铝金属中框，搭载了高通骁龙 845 移动平台，内置 3400mAh 电池。
items.summary_en: Developer Yanei has posted a video showing iOS 16.5 running on a Xiaomi 8, with the device spoofed as an iPhone X. The developer says initial GPU stutter was largely fixed and the home screen and animations are now fairly smooth, but the project remains an early port with many hardware drivers still needing work and is not ready for daily use. The Xiaomi 8 launched in May 2018 with a 6.21-inch AMOLED notch display, Snapdragon 845 and 3,400mAh battery.
items.why_zh: 体现开发者社区对跨系统移植的持续探索，也提示早期移植在驱动与稳定性上的挑战。
items.why_en: It shows ongoing community efforts in cross-platform OS porting and the driver and stability challenges of early builds.

items.title_zh: 小鹏汽车官宣在欧洲四国实现累计销量破万，覆盖丹麦、挪威、法国、德国
items.title_en: XPeng Hits 10,000 Cumulative Sales in Four European Countries, With G6 and G9 Topping Local Segments
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，小鹏汽车官方昨日宣布，在欧洲四国（丹麦、挪威、法国、德国）实现了累计销量破万， 同时小鹏 G6 和 G9 也多次获得了当地销量第一 。 据IT之家此前报道，在小鹏 G9L 巴黎车展全球上市发布会上，小鹏集团董事长、CEO 何小鹏表示，2026 年上半年，小鹏在法国的销量位居中国新势力品牌第一。何小鹏还表示， 目标是到 2030 年底全球年销量达到 100 万辆，其中欧洲占一半 。 值得一提的是，欧洲本地首台小鹏 G9L 已于 10 月 7 日在麦格纳奥地利工厂顺利完成试制。小鹏集团还当选了联合国欧洲经济委员会（UNECE）GRVA / WP.29 框架下，新设的“自动驾驶场景相关信息交换工作组”（TF-ESRI）秘书长。 这也是中国企业首次在联合国自动驾驶法规核心框架下担任秘书长 。 延伸阅读 据小鹏汽车公布的细分市场数据，小鹏 G6 在丹麦成为 2026 年中国纯电车型销量第一，在法国、德国获得 2026 年第三季度中国新势力纯电中型 SUV 销量榜首；小鹏 G9 则在挪威获得 2026 年中国新势力纯电中大型 SUV 销量第一。 小鹏汽车的出海布局最早自挪威开启，目前海外市场业务已扩展至数十个国家和地区。官方数据显示，其海外累计交付量已超过 10 万台，其中欧洲市场贡献约 60% 的份额；2026 年第二季度海外单季销量首次突破 2 万台，同比…
items.summary_en: XPeng said cumulative sales in Denmark, Norway, France and Germany have passed 10,000 units, with the G6 and G9 repeatedly ranking first in local segments. The company says overseas deliveries now exceed 100,000 units, about 60% of them in Europe, and that a locally built G9L completed a trial build at Magna's Austrian plant.
items.why_zh: 这是中国新势力车企在欧洲从“试水”走向规模化的重要信号，也关系到其本地化生产与全球百万销量目标的落地。
items.why_en: It signals that a Chinese EV startup is moving from testing the waters to real scale in Europe, a key step toward its local production plans and global sales goals.

items.summary_en: China News Service reports a new release of an open-source AI model at the 3-trillion-parameter scale, described as the largest open-source model update globally. Such scale typically brings stronger general capability but also higher inference and deployment costs.
items.why_zh: 开源模型参数规模跃升到 3 万亿级，将直接影响企业自建与二次开发的门槛与选择。
items.why_en: Pushing open-source models to the 3-trillion-parameter scale directly affects the cost and options for companies building on or self-hosting them.

items.why_en: After a quiet stretch, renewed iteration from a leading Chinese lab reshapes how developers and enterprises choose their models.

items.title_zh: Google更新隐私政策：个性化AI功能或让Gmail、Photos数据用于广告
items.title_en: Now Google says it might use your Gmail and Google Photos data to target ads
items.summary_zh: Google更新隐私政策，为“不将Drive、Gmail、Google Photos数据用于个性化广告”的承诺增加了例外条款。Android Authority发现，10月16日起政策新增表述：除非用户选择将这些服务的数据提供给支持个性化广告的其他Google服务。这意味着使用个性化AI功能并授权数据打通的部分用户，可能看到基于其个人数据投放的广告。政策变化引发对AI功能与广告边界、用户知情同意的关注。
items.summary_en: Google has updated its privacy policy in a way that could mean you'll start seeing targeted ads based on your personal data if you're using personalized AI features. The update, spotted by Android Authority , adds an exception to its promise about not using your Drive, Gmail, or Google Photos for personalized ads. While the previous version simply said it wouldn't do that, as of October 16th, Google has added the line, "unless you choose to make data from these services available to other Google services that support personalized ads." That means anyone who has connected their Drive, Gmail, or…
items.why_zh: AI个性化功能与广告数据打通，可能模糊用户对隐私承诺的预期，影响知情同意。
items.why_en: The change could blur the line between personalized AI features and ad targeting, raising consent and privacy-expectation concerns.

items.why_en: The “sovereign AI” discussion reflects enterprises’ demand for data security and greater control.

items.title_zh: Canva 推出首个自研 AI 图像模型：先生成设计方案，再生成图像
items.title_en: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
items.summary_zh: Canva 发布首个自研图像生成模型 Canva Craft，直接对标 OpenAI、微软与 Google 的相关产品。该模型采用两阶段架构，先生成设计方案再生成图像，官方称这带来“更高的精确度、一致性与可控性”。Canva Craft 最高可生成 2K 分辨率图像，并支持 30 多种画幅比例。除社交媒体配图与营销素材外，它还被定位为可生成写实场景、数字艺术与环境类图像。
items.summary_en: Canva is diving even deeper into AI with the launch of an image generation model that competes directly with those from OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google. The model, called Canva Craft , uses a two-stage architecture that allows it to plan a design before generating an image, allowing for "greater precision, consistency and control," according to an announcement on Thursday . Canva Craft can generate images at up to 2K resolution and in more than 30 aspect ratios. In addition to generating social media posts and marketing content, it's also supposed to create realistic scenes, digital art, environ…
items.why_zh: 设计平台自研模型并采用“先规划后生成”的架构，是图像生成走向可控化、生产级应用的一个信号。
items.why_en: A design platform building its own plan-then-generate model signals image generation moving toward controllable, production-grade use.

items.title_zh: 如何设计一套可持续演进的 AI 服务推理框架
items.title_en: Designing an AI serving harness built to last
items.summary_zh: 文章指出，企业 AI 的下一个竞争优势，与其说取决于选择哪个模型，不如说取决于围绕模型构建了什么。过去几年行业焦点集中在模型能力——更大的模型、更强的推理、更长的上下文窗口和更高的基准分数，这些进步固然显著。但随着 AI 从实验走向生产，企业面临的问题已从“模型能做什么”转变为“能否可靠、经济且大规模地交付这种智能”。文章由此讨论 AI 服务推理框架（serving harness）的设计思路，强调其需要面向长期演进。
items.summary_en: The next competitive advantage in enterprise AI has less to do with which model you choose than with what you build around it. That’s an important shift. For the past several years, much of the AI conversation has centered on model capability: bigger models, better reasoning, larger context windows, higher benchmark scores. Those advances have been extraordinary. But as AI moves from experimentation to production, the question facing enterprise leaders has changed—it’s no longer, “what can the model do?”—it’s now, “Can we deliver that intelligence reliably, economically, and at scale?” Increas…
items.why_zh: 当 AI 进入生产环境，推理服务框架的工程质量往往比模型选型更决定成败。
items.why_en: In production, the engineering of the serving harness often matters more to success than which model is chosen.

items.title_zh: Meta重新启用Muse分享功能
items.title_en: Meta turns Muse sharing back on
items.summary_zh: Meta已重新启用Muse的对话分享功能。此前安全研究人员发现，Muse共享对话的公开链接很容易被找到，甚至能检索到营销公司内部营收评估和小企业主贷款申请等页面。Claroc本周早些时候指出，这些共享对话的网址以对话标题命名并写入公共DNS；Ars Technica称Meta在被询问后暂停了该功能，随后Meta在X发帖宣布恢复。
items.summary_en: Meta has re-enabled Muse sharing after security researchers had reported that public conversation links could be easy to find. The researchers said they had been able to find Muse pages like a marketing company's internal revenue review and a small business owner's loan application. Researchers at Claroc reported earlier this week that Muse the web addresses for shared conversations from Muse were named after a conversation's title and written into public DNS. Ars Technica said Tuesday that Meta paused the sharing feature after it reached out about what was going on. In a post today on X, Meta…
items.why_zh: 事件凸显AI对话分享功能中的隐私与链接可发现性风险，平台需在便利与安全间取得平衡。
items.why_en: The episode highlights privacy and link-discoverability risks in AI conversation sharing, forcing platforms to balance convenience and safety.

items.title_zh: 好吧，把SpaceX和特斯拉合并，谁在乎
items.title_en: Sure, let’s smoosh SpaceX and Tesla together, who cares
items.summary_zh: 特斯拉与SpaceX已成立特别委员会，讨论潜在合并事宜。文章指出，SpaceX因计划再借400亿美元用于购买Nvidia芯片而信用风险较高，但合并讨论仍在推进。作者认为，这笔合并是否具有吸引力，很大程度上取决于人们是否相信马斯克关于前往火星、“传播意识之光”的愿景。
items.summary_en: Mars not depicted. | Image: Cath Virginia / The Verge, Getty Images Oh sure, SpaceX's credit risk is pretty high because it's about to borrow another $40 billion to spend on Nvidia chips , but who cares about that? SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss a merger! The degree to which you find this merger compelling likely has to do with the degree to which you believe Elon Musk about wanting to go to Mars, or "spread the light of consciousness," as he put it in this week's SpaceX earnings call (and earlier S-1). Now, a reasonably informed person knows that we don't have the…
items.why_zh: 马斯克旗下两大公司的潜在合并涉及治理、融资风险与战略优先级，值得关注。
items.why_en: A potential merger of two major Musk-led companies raises governance, financing-risk and strategic-focus questions.

items.title_zh: 博通 vs. 戴尔：2026 年哪只 AI 受益股更值得买？
items.title_en: Broadcom vs. Dell Technologies: Which Stock Is AI Powering to Be a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary_zh: 《Motley Fool》文章对比博通与戴尔科技，讨论在 AI 需求推动下，哪家公司股票在 2026 年更值得买入。文章聚焦两家公司受 AI 业务驱动的程度与投资吸引力，但提供的摘要未给出最终结论或具体财务对比。对投资者而言，这反映出 AI 基础设施与硬件链仍是市场关注重点。
items.summary_en: Broadcom vs. Dell Technologies: Which Stock Is AI Powering to Be a Better Buy in 2026? The Motley Fool
items.why_zh: AI 投资正从芯片扩展到服务器与基础设施，龙头公司的估值比较影响资金流向。
items.why_en: AI investing is expanding from chips to servers and infrastructure, making comparisons of leading companies important for capital flows.

items.title_zh: 专家警告：AI 发现的漏洞可能很快引发新一轮混乱
items.title_en: AI-discovered bugs may soon trigger fresh disruptions, experts say
items.summary_zh: 有专家警告，AI 发现的软件漏洞或缺陷可能很快引发新一轮服务中断或安全混乱。报道的核心观点是，随着 AI 工具加速漏洞发现，相关风险可能更集中地暴露出来，给企业应急响应带来压力。现有信息未披露具体漏洞案例或受影响系统，但这一警告凸显 AI 在网络安全攻防两端的双刃剑效应。
items.summary_en: AI-discovered bugs may soon trigger fresh disruptions, experts say Honolulu Star-Advertiser
items.why_zh: AI 提升漏洞发现效率的同时，也可能压缩修复窗口，改变网络安全攻防节奏。
items.why_en: AI can speed vulnerability discovery while shrinking patching windows, changing the tempo of cybersecurity offense and defense.

items.title_zh: 俄亥俄州劳工团体支持立法：规范州政府机构使用 AI
items.title_en: Ohio labor groups back bill regulating AI use by state agencies
items.summary_zh: 俄亥俄州多个劳工团体表态支持一项法案，旨在规范州政府机构对人工智能的使用。报道显示，该法案聚焦政府场景中的 AI 应用监管，劳工组织的支持为其增加了推动力。现有信息未披露法案具体条款，但事件反映出美国州层面正加快对公共部门 AI 使用的规则探索。
items.summary_en: Ohio labor groups back bill regulating AI use by state agencies WKBN.com
items.why_zh: 公共部门使用 AI 涉及透明度、问责与劳工权益，州级立法可能成为其他地区参考。
items.why_en: AI use in the public sector raises transparency, accountability, and labor concerns, and state-level rules could become models for others.

items.title_zh: ABA Technology 在 GTC Berlin 向黄仁勋展示 Fusion AI In-a-Box
items.title_en: ABA Technology Presents Fusion AI In-a-Box to Jensen Huang, CEO and Founder of Nvidia, at GTC Berlin
items.summary_zh: 在 GTC Berlin 上，ABA Technology 向 Nvidia 首席执行官兼创始人黄仁勋展示了 Fusion AI In-a-Box。该消息突出了 ABA Technology 的 Fusion AI 产品方案与 Nvidia 领导层的同台互动，地点为 Nvidia 的 GTC 活动。现有信息未披露该方案的具体规格、合作细节或商业进展，但“In-a-Box”形式显示其主打打包式 AI 部署。
items.summary_en: ABA Technology Presents Fusion AI In-a-Box to Jensen Huang, CEO and Founder of Nvidia, at GTC Berlin Atalayar
items.why_zh: 在 Nvidia GTC 上向黄仁勋展示产品，意味着打包式 AI 方案正争取与算力生态更紧密对接。
items.why_en: Presenting to Jensen Huang at Nvidia GTC signals that packaged AI solutions are seeking closer ties to the compute ecosystem.

items.title_zh: WSJ 独家：FBI 研究对沙特籍 OpenAI 相关嫌疑人提起间谍案
items.title_en: Exclusive | FBI Explores Espionage Case Against Saudi OpenAI Suspect
items.summary_zh: 《华尔街日报》独家报道称，FBI 正在研究是否对一名与 OpenAI 相关的沙特籍嫌疑人按间谍案处理。报道显示，案件涉及美国执法部门对 AI 领域国家安全风险的审视，但现有信息未披露嫌疑人身份、具体指控或 OpenAI 的回应。此事若推进，可能加剧外界对 AI 实验室安全与人员审查的关注。
items.summary_en: Exclusive | FBI Explores Espionage Case Against Saudi OpenAI Suspect WSJ
items.why_zh: AI 实验室掌握敏感技术，相关案件显示 AI 行业正成为国家安全与反间谍关注前沿。
items.why_en: AI labs hold sensitive technology, and the case shows the industry is becoming a front line for national security and counterespionage scrutiny.

items.title_zh: 从 slop 到 non-slop：AI 领域的新大主题是数量
items.title_en: From slop to non-slop: The new big AI theme is quantity
items.summary_zh: 据 Asia Times 文章，AI 领域出现一个新的重大主题——数量。标题用“从 slop 到 non-slop”概括这一转向，暗示行业关注点正从大量低质量内容转向非低质量内容，而规模或数量成为核心变量。由于提供的原文摘要仅包含标题和来源，未给出具体公司、数据或案例，尚无法判断这一判断的具体依据。读者需查看原文了解其具体论证。
items.summary_en: From slop to non-slop: The new big AI theme is quantity Asia Times
items.why_zh: 它提示 AI 内容生态的竞争焦点可能从质量争议转向规模与数量，但具体影响仍需原文细节支撑。
items.why_en: It signals that the AI content debate may be shifting toward scale and quantity, though the full implications depend on details not included in the excerpt.

items.title_zh: 继 Anthropic 之后，OpenAI 意识到必须改变 AI 模型训练方式
items.title_en: After Anthropic, OpenAI realises it needs to change the way it trains its AI models; admits: Our model ma
items.summary_zh: 据 The Times of India 报道，继 Anthropic 之后，OpenAI 认识到需要改变其训练 AI 模型的方式。报道还称 OpenAI 承认“我们的模型……”（Our model ma），但提供的摘要在此处截断，完整表述不明。现有信息未说明 OpenAI 将具体调整哪些训练方法、涉及哪些模型以及时间表。
items.summary_en: After Anthropic, OpenAI realises it needs to change the way it trains its AI models; admits: Our model ma The Times of India
items.why_zh: 若头部实验室调整训练方式，可能影响模型能力、安全性与行业竞争格局。
items.why_en: If leading labs change their training methods, it could affect model capabilities, safety, and competitive dynamics.
